summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Audit findings (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the whole chain before planning anything, since "the backend probably has a wiring bug" was the ticket's working theory and I wanted to know if that's even true.  **What's actually solid, confirmed by reading the code:** - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — every route (`GET /`, `GET /:id`, item add/remove) filters by `watchlists.user_id`, correctly scoped. No default/anonymous watchlist creation. - The watchlist router has its own `use("*", ...)` auth middleware (handlers.ts:13-21) that validates the session cookie and sets `X-User-Id`
